firstPrompt: what grocery stores do i shop at the most?

messages.content: what grocery stores do i shop at the most?

You shop at **QFC** the most, accounting for 19 of your grocery transactions. Following that, there are 5 transactions categorized as "Other Aplpay Groceries," which may represent other stores you've shopped at using Aplpay that weren't explicitly identified as QFC. You also have single transactions at "Seattle," "Quality Food Centers" (which is QFC), and "Plaid Pantry."

charts.title: Most Shopped Grocery Stores
charts.subtitle: By transaction count
charts.sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN transactions.category = 'Groceries' AND transactions.payee LIKE '%Aplpay%' AND transactions.description LIKE '%QFC%' THEN 'QFC'
        WHEN transactions.category = 'Groceries' AND transactions.payee LIKE '%Aplpay%' AND transactions.description LIKE '%LIF%' THEN 'LIF'
        WHEN transactions.category = 'Groceries' AND transactions.payee LIKE '%Aplpay%' THEN 'Other Aplpay Groceries'
        WHEN transactions.category = 'Groceries' THEN transactions.payee
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE transactions.hidden = 0
AND COALESCE(transactions.category, '') != 'Internal Transfer'
AND transactions.category = 'Groceries'
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5

charts.title: Most Shopped Grocery Stores (All Time)
charts.subtitle: All transactions since July 2025
charts.sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(payee, '')) LIKE '%qfc%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%qfc%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payee, '')) LIKE '%quality food centers%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%quality food centers%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payee, '')) LIKE '%aplpay%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%aplpay%' THEN 'QFC'
        WHEN category = 'Groceries' THEN COALESCE(payee, description, 'Unspecified Grocery Store')
        ELSE 'Unspecified Grocery Store'
    END AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE hidden = 0
AND COALESCE(category, '') != 'Internal Transfer'
AND category = 'Groceries'
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY value DESC
